requirements.verifier_assertion: test.sh invokes the candidate as `python solution.py --input <dir> --output <file>` and reads the JSON it writes; a solution using a different CLI contract produces no output and fails.
test.sh checks the md5 of game_state.json before and after running the solution; modifying any input file fails the read-only assertion.
must_include: Reading the input must not modify any input file

requirements.verifier_assertion: The reference impl emits result.json with exactly the five top-level keys, 2-space indented; missing/extra keys or a different shape fail equality.
The reference impl treats faction id "player" and the six axial offsets as given; deviating breaks adjacency and candidate detection in the random cases.
must_include: The player faction id is the string "player"

requirements.verifier_assertion: CASE B and the random cases apply buildings_override.json at the field level; overriding whole buildings instead of individual fields diverges.
must_include: a field present in the override replaces that field
appears only in the override is added

requirements.verifier_assertion: The reference impl makes the first occurrence of a (q,r) authoritative and reports later repeats only as invalid; using a later tile as authoritative diverges.
must_include: The first occurrence of a coordinate is authoritative

requirements.verifier_assertion: CASE A/D and random cases select candidate tiles by owner null, building null, buildable terrain, and player-adjacency; a wrong condition set changes buildable_tiles.
must_include: owner is null, building is null
at least one of its six axial neighbors is a tile owned by "player"

requirements.verifier_assertion: The reference impl includes a building as an option only when terrain is allowed and the stockpile affords the full cost, absent resources counting as 0.
must_include: the stockpile can afford every entry of the building's cost
a resource absent from the stockpile counts as 0

requirements.verifier_assertion: options are ordered by total cost then id, and a zero-option candidate is still listed with []; wrong ordering or dropping empty-option tiles fails CASE A.
must_include: ties broken by building id ascending
zero options is still listed with an empty options array

requirements.verifier_assertion: buildable_tiles are sorted by q then r; tiles reported invalid with reason unknown_terrain or placed_building_unknown are excluded, while a duplicate_coord entry excludes only the duplicate tile and leaves the authoritative first occurrence eligible (CASE C asserts the first occurrence of (0,1) stays buildable despite a later duplicate). Unsorted output or wrongly excluding the authoritative first occurrence fails.
must_include: sorted by q ascending, then r ascending
duplicate_coord entry excludes only the duplicate tile itself

requirements.verifier_assertion: production sums base_output*(workers_assigned/workers_required) over placed known buildings, with 0 when workers_required is 0; a different formula diverges on the random cases.
must_include: if workers_required is 0 the contribution is 0
summed over every authoritative tile whose building is a known merged building

requirements.verifier_assertion: production keys are exactly the placed known buildings' output_resource (0.0 included), rounded to 1dp round-half-up, with no invented resources.
must_include: rounded to 1 decimal place using round-half-up

requirements.verifier_assertion: net_food_per_turn is food production (0.0 if absent) minus population.adults, rounded 1dp round-half-up.
survival is survive/weak/collapse against the >=0 and >= -adults*0.25 thresholds; wrong bands fail CASE A and random cases.
invalid_tiles use the first applicable reason in the fixed order duplicate_coord/unknown_terrain/placed_building_unknown, sorted by q then r, with unowned null tiles never invalid.
must_include: first applicable reason in this order
An owner of null is a normal unowned tile and is never invalid on its own

requirements.verifier_assertion: The reference impl subtracts one food per adult; a different per-adult consumption diverges on net_food and survival.
must_include: each adult consumes exactly 1 food per turn
